utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m pretty sure it’s this weekend—maybe Saturday—but I’d really like to check with Mina so I don’t muddle it again.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, that sounds right from what I’ve heard, but I’d check with Mina too—last I caught, the bigger loose end was still who’s collecting tools and where folks should drop them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—that part slipped my mind. I can ask Mina about the day and the tool drop-off too, just so I don’t send anyone the wrong way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Right now the main gaps are still extension cords and work gloves, Noah; duct tape’s covered, and I’ve got one spare tarp on hand.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, good to know—thanks. I think Saturday was the plan, but I might be mixing it up, so maybe I should check with Mina before I show up with the wrong stuff.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, that’s worth checking with Mina first—if Saturday’s right, extension cords or work gloves would still be the most useful things to bring.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it—I’ll be there around 3:15 and can do a pickup run first, then help sort.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Leo—that pickup run will help a ton, and we can sort everything once you get in around 3:15.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—I’ll head over for 3:15 and start with the pickup run.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I told Rosa I’d handle check-in and help organize volunteers, so I want to make sure we’ve got the repair drive timing right with Mina before we lock anything in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That helps a lot—right now I’ve got six confirmed, with intake still the thinnest spot, so if Mina can find two or three more people, especially one for check-in and one for cleanup, we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds manageable, and I’m still set to cover check-in myself. Once Mina confirms the timing, I can also help Rosa see whether we still need that extra cleanup person.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can we confirm the storage spot first, and is Faye definitely the one coordinating missed drop-offs if people aren’t home?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, let’s confirm the storage spot first, and as far as I know Faye’s still the one handling missed drop-offs if folks aren’t home.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can we get that confirmed for sure before we commit, and which storage spot is actually secure?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Still no firm date, but everyone I’ve talked to sounds ready to jump in the moment it’s announced.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to hear, Tess. Let’s keep it orderly and have a simple repair list ready, so we can line them up one by one as soon as the date’s set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely—I’ll keep spreading the word, and once we get the date, I’ll send folks your way with that repair list in mind.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ve been mentioning it while I’m out—the repair drive’s coming up, and right now folks especially need extension cords and work gloves, plus a spare tarp if anyone has one.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That helps—I’ll note extension cords, work gloves, and a spare tarp on the check-in list, and I’ll ask Mara, Ben, and the Nguyens first since they’re closest to the community garden setup.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect—that matches what I’ve been hearing, and I’ll keep spreading the word while I’m out in case someone can spare those.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly just sorting and a couple of pickup runs still, I think. If Bo can check the timing with Mina, that’d put my mind at ease.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’ll check with Mina on timing. For the drive, we still need extension cords and work gloves first, and a spare tarp if one turns up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I can bring the gloves I’ve got, but I’m not sure about a tarp just yet.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m leaning toward after school since I can stay through pickup; right now it’s mostly bikes, a couple of scooters, and one stroller brake, with Amir on tools and Denise handling check-in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds like it’s taking shape nicely. I still haven’t heard a firm date from anyone else, but if that timing sticks, it seems like folks will be ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s where I’m at too—if after school still looks best, I’ll try to pin down a day next and make sure we’ve got enough hands for the bikes, scooters, and that stroller brake.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Rosa, I’m telling everyone the repair drive’s coming up, so bring any broken stuff by and pitch in if you can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — and please let folks know it’s now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch. I’m putting together a simple flow so we can keep check-in and volunteers organized.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Rosa — I’ll keep telling everyone it’s Sunday at the community center now, and to bring their broken stuff by and pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Quinn, do you know anyone who can take intake or cleanup? Sam’s got six confirmed, but we still need two or three more and intake’s the thinnest.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll ask around the block right now and see who can cover intake or cleanup, since intake sounds like the pinch point. Once I’ve got a few names, I’ll add them to the repair list so we can line the drive up cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—can you check intake first and let me know today if you find at least one more for that and one for cleanup?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Dane, I need the storage spot and the person handling missed drop-offs confirmed before I can feel okay about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late again, Pia—I’ll confirm the storage spot right now and check who’s covering missed drop-offs so we can keep it simple and moving.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Alright, but I need both of those confirmed clearly before we commit, because that’s where this can get messy fast.
